ruleDefinitions.name: Renamed AdFind Execution
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the use of a renamed Adfind.exe. AdFind continues to be seen across majority of breaches. It is used to domain trust discovery to plan out subsequent steps in the attack chain.

sequences.query: ((process_command_line = RGX(".*domainlist.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*trustdmp.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*dcmodes.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*adinfo.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ dclist\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*computer\\_pwdnotreqd.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*objectcategory\\=.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-subnets\\ \\-f.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*name\\=\\"Domain\\ Admins\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-sc\\ u\\:.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*domainncs.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*dompol.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ oudmp\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*subnetdmp.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*gpodmp.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*fspdmp.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*users\\_noexpire.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*computers\\_active.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*computers\\_pwdnotreqd.*")) OR (process_hash = RGX(".*IMPHASH\\=BCA5675746D13A1F246E2DA3C2217492.*") OR process_hash = RGX(".*IMPHASH\\=53E117A96057EAF19C41380D0E87F1C2.*") OR process_hash = RGX(".*IMPHASH\\=d144de8117df2beceaba2201ad304764.*") OR process_hash = RGX(".*IMPHASH\\=12ce1c0f3f5837ecc18a3782408fa975.*") OR process_hash = RGX(".*IMPHASH\\=4fbf3f084fbbb2470b80b2013134df35.*") OR process_hash = RGX(".*IMPHASH\\=49b639b4acbecc49d72a01f357aa4930.*") OR process_hash = RGX(".*IMPHASH\\=680dad9e300346e05a85023965867201.*") OR process_hash = RGX(".*IMPHASH\\=21aa085d54992511b9f115355e468782.*")) OR process_original_file_name = "AdFind\.exe") AND  NOT (process_path = RGX("\\\\AdFind\\\.exe$"))
